item.text:
Further refactored the codebase into clearer responsibilities:

- [DetectCycle.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/029_detect_cycle_directed_graph/DetectCycle.java:1) is now only the demo/entrypoint.
- [CycleDetector.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/029_detect_cycle_directed_graph/CycleDetector.java:1) contains the cycle-detection algorithm.
- [DirectedGraph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/029_detect_cycle_directed_graph/DirectedGraph.java:1) owns graph construction, edge insertion, and vertex validation.

What improved:
- The algorithm is isolated from the executable demo.
- The public API is narrower and easier to reason about.
- The graph object remains the single source of truth for structure and bounds checking.
- Helper methods are now scoped to the class that uses them.

- `java DetectCycle`
